The internet is filled with Myths on how the Stock Market can make money for you.
So in this video we decided to debunk 4 biggest myths around the markets!
1. Set and Forget:
Everyone on the internet tells you to set up an SIP and then forget!
But all equity is not the same and how you invest, if you do an SIP or invest the money lump sum plays a big role on the 'Set and Forget' rule turns out for you.
2. Living off Dividend Income:
Dividend Income is one of the most commonly sold ideas of Passive Income.
The Idea is absolutely TRUE but partly!
